statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low because delayed NQ has shown a two-way European handoff with a substantial rebound from the session low rather than persistent extension; Stress remains extreme around geopolitical energy risk and the 12:30-14:00 UTC U.S. event cluster.
recommendation: Tail remains below the blocking threshold. A stronger mapped state would require later NQ structure to show persistent extension with shallow or failed retracements, especially through the 12:30-14:00 UTC event sequence.
headline: Two-way NQ handoff keeps Tail low ahead of the U.S. data cluster
body: Delayed NQ was 29,167 at 07:50 Berlin, down 0.07%, after opening near 29,207, falling to 29,075 and rebounding well off the low. Reuters reported firmer global equities and easing U.S. Treasury yields, while Brent remained near $95 amid unresolved U.S.-Iran and Hormuz risk. The current path does not show repeated extension or failed mean reversion.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 clock-hours moved from elevated Tail readings during September 2 into WATCH and then low Tail as U.S. price action recovered and overnight NQ mean reversion re-emerged. The September 2 22:00 UTC slot remains unavailable because no valid published ChatGPT assessment exists for that hour.
outlookSummary: The highest conditional risk is concentrated from 12:15 to 14:45 UTC on September 3 around the 12:30 U.S. trade, productivity, claims and Waller cluster, the 13:30 cash open and the 14:00 ISM Services release. Forecast Tail peaks at WATCH and remains below the blocking threshold unless observed NQ structure becomes persistent and poorly retraced.

After the cash close, lower liquidity can widen moves, but Tail stays low unless post-close repricing becomes persistent.
Early evening Tail stays low if post-close discovery is orderly. Geopolitical headlines can keep Stress elevated without proving a one-way NQ path.
Overnight Tail stays low absent a fresh directional discontinuity. Energy and geopolitical headlines remain the main Stress channel.
At the Asia handoff, low Tail assumes normal two-way liquidity. A gap plus repeated continuation would be stronger evidence than Friday's scheduled jobs report.
Early Asia risk remains mostly Stress if NQ retraces normally. Tail rises only if a directional gap holds and successive pullbacks fail.
As Asian liquidity deepens, low Tail remains conditional on normal retracements. Yield, oil and semiconductor alignment would strengthen one-way risk.
Friday's employment report is closer, lifting Stress, but Tail stays low while no post-release path exists. Overnight NQ structure remains decisive.
Pre-European Friday trading reaches WATCH as the employment report moves nearer. The score still assumes no persistent one-way NQ structure has been observed.
